test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All beds are cots.

2. All sofas are beds.

**Conclusions:**

I. All sofas are cots.

II. Some beds are sofas.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8c1255ec4ac19028a994a2626f4c852b4c23628abf0060933429fd01014173f.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All sofas are cots. → **Follows** (As, All beds are cots and All sofas are beds)

II. Some beds are sofas. → **Follows **(As, All sofas are beds)

Hence,** ****both conclusions I and II follow**.
